goal: Stop a pull request from dropping or loosening the change record check that judges it (H13). The check is a step of validate, and validate runs the pull request's own validate.yml and debrief.py.
changed: New check change-record, from .github/workflows/change-record.yml on pull_request_target: it runs main's debrief.py against the pull request's merge commit, checked out as data. No code from the pull request runs.
A change to debrief.py is checked by the old debrief.py, and takes effect from the next pull request on.
Nothing requires it yet. Beau adds it to the ruleset once it has passed on a real pull request (H13 step 1); then the step leaves validate.

claims.claim: The new workflow runs and passes on pull requests to main.
claims.remaining: GitHub runs pull_request_target only from the default branch, so it can't run before this merges. The first pull request after the merge shows it; the H13 run records that run before Beau requires the check.

claims.claim: debrief.py runs under python -I and reads its exempt list from itself, not from the checked tree.
claims.remaining: Read from debrief.py (BOOKKEEPING is a constant, imports are standard library only) and run locally under -I with --root on a checkout; not run in CI until merge.

next.item: Require change-record in the protect main ruleset
next.why_now: Until then a pull request can still drop the step from validate and merge
next.impact: The change record check is out of the pull request's reach

next.item: Drop the change record step from validate.yml
next.why_now: After the requirement, the step is a duplicate the pull request controls
next.impact: One change record check per pull request

release.none: CI only; contributors see one more check on each pull request.
